raw:
Agent Name: FileSurfer
, Step Number: 16
, Reason for Mistake: FileSurfer falsely reported a successful download and saved an invalid placeholder path (“/workspace/http:/export.arxiv.org/pdf/2007.xx”) instead of the actual PDFs (arXiv:2103.07786 and the correct July 2020 paper). This prevented extracting the X-ray time spans, derailed the comparison, and led to the incorrect final answer (31) rather than the correct 0.2.
